whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm global.conf no longer carries an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time.
